articles.title: Policeman martyred, 3 missing in terrorist attack on Hangu checkpost: DPO
articles.description: HANGU - A policeman was martyred and three others got missing after militants attacked on check post at Shah Almas Pir Pahari on Monday night.

articles.title: Polish terrorist killed in Cracow attack, mobile phone unknown
articles.description: The suspect died in the hospital after being injured during his detention. The authorities are investigating the attack, which caused six dead and 16 wounded.

articles.title: Krakow Shooter Dies After Killing Six in Terrorist Attack
articles.description: The 24-year-old gunman responsible for a shooting in Krakow's Main Square has died in the hospital, while police discovered the bodies of his parents and sister at their home, confirming the incident as a terrorist offense with international victims.

articles.title: Deadly militant attack leaves over 50 dead in Ethiopia
articles.description: More than 50 people have been killed in an attack by armed militants on the settlement of Daleti in western Ethiopia, the Borkena news portal reported, citing regional police.

articles.title: Poland calls Krakow shooting rampage a 'terrorist' attack
